title: Instance
description: Schema for an instance — project-specific use of a definition. Per OBJECT-MODEL.md §2. Always origin=project. Parameter values are either value: or ref: (mutually exclusive). default: is forbidden on instances.

definition.description: id of the definition this instance points at.

origin.description: Instances live only in projects. Always 'project'.

parameters.description: Concrete parameter values. Each entry has 'value' or 'ref' but not both. Omission is also valid (accepts the definition's default).

ref.description: Reference to a project-scoped Active Variable. Forbidden on definitions; legal here.

properties.description: Per-instance concrete values for composed-part properties, keyed by '<role>.<property>' (e.g. 'geometry.length'). Gives this instance's geometry/material real dimensions so a derived equation like R = rho*L/A evaluates per-instance against this part, not the shared shape definition. Per OBJECT-MODEL.md §16.

connects.description: Net / terminal / device connections. Ad-hoc shape per OBJECT-MODEL.md §2 example; formal net model deferred per §15.
